task_summary: Implement one-level list flattening in solution.py and add standard-library unittest coverage in test_solution.py.
constraints: Work only in the supplied task workspace; do not access parent repositories or external services.
Use Python 3.11+ and the standard library.
Flatten exactly one list level, preserve order, ignore empty inner lists, return a new list, and do not modify inner lists or mutate input collections.
Maintain type hints; no algorithmic complexity constraint is imposed.
test_solution.py must contain at least two passing unittest test methods exercising the public API.

success_criteria.description: solution.py is present and defines the public flatten function with type hints.
test_solution.py is present and defines at least two unittest test methods.
Tests cover ordinary, boundary, and empty inputs and exercise the public flatten API.
